# ===== BUSINESS OVERVIEW =====

Description: Cold Fix Services is an appliance, air conditioning, and refrigeration repair business serving homes and businesses across Gauteng, South Africa. We handle everything from a fridge that has stopped cooling to full air conditioning installation and commercial cold room work, with one trusted team you only need to call once.

Response Time: Same day callouts available across Gauteng
Emergency Support: 24/7 for cooling and refrigeration breakdowns

Mission: Keep homes and businesses across Gauteng cool and running with fast, honest, professional repairs and reliable service.

All service pages use clean URLs in the pattern /[service-name].

1. Air Conditioning Services
